declarations.name: AuiNetworkGraph

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Chart title: visible text and the accessible name of the plot (aria-labelledby); also the data table caption.

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the title; it stays the accessible name.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Visible description below the title, also referenced by aria-describedby (text only).

inputs.name: summary
inputs.description: Replaces the generated accessible summary (node, edge, and group counts, the most connected node, nodes without connections, hidden groups).

inputs.name: valueFormat
inputs.description: Number format for values in the tooltip and table.

inputs.name: formatValue
inputs.description: Custom value text; overrides valueFormat everywhere.

inputs.name: theme
inputs.description: Look and feel: { palette?: string[] (1-8 CSS colors for slots 1-8); fontFamily?; fontSize? (8-32 px); textColor?; gridLines?: boolean; gridColor?; gridDash?; axisColor?; lineWidth?; markerSize?; cornerRadius?; barRadius?; cellRadius?; sliceRadius?; boxRadius?; swatchRadius?; tooltipRadius?; controlRadius?; lineJoin?; areaOpacity?; gradient?; valueLabelColor?; tooltip?: { background?, color?, borderColor? }; legendPosition?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'start' | 'end'; animation?: boolean | { duration?: number } }. Applied as --aui-chart-* custom properties and classes on the host through the CSSOM (CSP-safe); colors are validated with CSS.supports('color'). Animation is opt-in and never runs with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or [data-aui-animation='none'].

inputs.name: renderTooltip
inputs.description: Custom tooltip content as DOM nodes (never HTML strings). context: { title, rows: { label, value, seriesId }[], column, row, source: "pointer" | "focus" | "sync" }. Return null for the default tooltip. The tooltip stays aria-hidden; the focused mark keeps its accessible label.

inputs.name: syncGroup
inputs.description: Shared chart option; a network graph has no column concept, so it has no effect.

inputs.name: nodes
inputs.description: Nodes: { id: string (unique, non-empty); label: string; group?: string (color, shape, legend); value?: number >= 0 (radius grows with its square root) }. At most 1,000.

inputs.name: edges
inputs.description: Edges: { source: node id; target: node id (not the source); weight?: positive number (line thickness, table) }. At most 5,000.

inputs.name: groups
inputs.description: Group labels, colors, and legend order: { id; label; color?: 1-8; colorValue?: CSS color }. Default: groups in order of first appearance, labelled by id; nodes without a group share one labelled "Other".

inputs.name: directed
inputs.description: Draw arrowheads at edge targets.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Layout seed (integer 0-4294967295): the same data and seed always give the same layout.

inputs.name: linkDistance
inputs.description: Preferred edge length in layout units (10-400).

inputs.name: charge
inputs.description: Node repulsion (1-2000).

inputs.name: pinned
inputs.description: Nodes fixed at a position in layout units: { id; x; y } (the coordinate space of positions). Dragging and Shift+Arrow add pins.

inputs.name: zoom
inputs.description: Zoom and pan: toolbar buttons, + / - / 0 keys, Ctrl/Cmd + wheel, drag on the background to pan, Shift + drag to select.

inputs.name: legend
inputs.description: Legend of node groups (toggle buttons): auto shows it with more than one group, show always, hide never.

inputs.name: dataTable
inputs.description: Data table fallback (an adjacency list: node, group, connection count, connected nodes with weights): behind a Show data table button (built on first open), always visible, visually hidden (screen readers only), or none.

inputs.name: tooltip
inputs.description: Tooltip on pointer hover and keyboard focus.

inputs.name: patterns
inputs.description: Shared chart option; groups already differ by marker shape, so it has no extra effect.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Plot height in CSS px (integer 120-2000); the width follows the container.

inputs.name: nodeLabels
inputs.description: Node labels: auto (graphs up to 50 visible nodes), always, or none.

inputs.name: animate
inputs.description: Animate the layout settling; never with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or animation: 'none' (the final layout is then computed before the first paint).

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Number, date, and message locale.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: rtl puts node labels on the left; the layout is not mirrored.

models.name: hiddenSeries
models.description: Ids of hidden groups (legend toggles): their nodes and edges are not drawn and not reachable.

outputs.name: pointClicked
outputs.description: A node was activated: pointer click or tap, or Enter / Space on the focused node. seriesId is the node id, series its group, value its connection count.

outputs.name: nodePinned
outputs.description: A node was pinned (drag end or Shift+Arrow) or unpinned (U); also announced politely.

outputs.name: seriesToggled
outputs.description: A group was shown or hidden from the legend.

outputs.name: zoomed
outputs.description: The visible window changed (fractions 0-1 of the layout bounds).

methods.name: setSeriesVisible
methods.description: Show or hide an item programmatically (no event).

methods.name: relayout
methods.description: Run the layout again from the current positions; pinned nodes stay.

methods.name: unpinAll
methods.description: Remove every pin (no event); call relayout() to let the nodes move.

accessibility.pattern: SVG node-link diagram as a named, described group (role="group" with aria-roledescription "network graph") of role="img" nodes with roving focus and neighbor navigation; legend of group toggle buttons; zoom toolbar; adjacency-list data table.

limitations: Pairwise repulsion is O(n^2) per step; very large graphs lay out slowly.
Dragging pins a node where it is dropped; other nodes keep their positions until the layout runs again (relayout() or new data).
Straight edges only; parallel edges overlap.
